free_tier_limits.correction: Starter includes 5,000,000 embedding tokens per month per model; bge-reranker-v2-m3 and pinecone-rerank-v0 each allow 500 rerank requests per month.

rate_limits.correction: Inference is limited to 100 requests/second and 2,000 requests/minute per project. Starter embedding and reranking limits are also model-specific.

cors.correction: Direct cross-origin browser requests can fail because Pinecone responses may omit the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header.

example.correction: curl -X POST "https://api.pinecone.io/embed" -H "Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Pinecone-Api-Version: 2026-04" -d '{"model":"multilingual-e5-large","parameters":{"input_type":"query"},"inputs":[{"text":"What is the capital of France?"}]}'

notes: The submitted guide URL now redirects to a general overview. The example uses an obsolete API version, supplies strings instead of input objects, and omits multilingual-e5-large's required input_type parameter. Api-Key is correct for Inference; Bearer access tokens documented elsewhere are for Admin API operations.
